articles.summary: FRISCO, TX / ACCESS Newswire / November 2, 2026 / GameSquare Holdings, Inc. (NASDAQ:GAME), ("GameSquare", or the "Company"), announced today that it expects to release its third-quarter 2026 financial results on Monday, November 16, 2026. A copy of the news release will be available on the investor website. Shareholders, investors, interested parties, and media are encouraged to join the Company's earnings call via webcast on Monday, November 16, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. ET. The call will be hosted by Justin Kenna, GameSquare's CEO and will be joined by other members of GameSquare's management team. Please join the call at: https://event.choruscall.com/mediaframe/webcast.html?webcastid=0g5DEKxa About GameSquare Holdings, Inc. GameSquare (NASDAQ:GAME) is a cutting-edge media, entertainment, and technology company transforming how brands and publishers connect with Gen Z, Gen Alpha, and Millennial audiences.
